name: Boon of Fluid Forms

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Once per Long Rest, become a Beast, Humanoid or Monstrosity of Challenge Rating 10 or lower for an hour, with its Hit Points as Temporary Hit Points; every shape change gives you 20 more Temporary Hit Points.

benefits.name: Fluid Shape
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, a Magic action turns you into a Beast, Humanoid or Monstrosity of CR 10 or lower for 1 hour, with Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points.
benefits.text: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action you take the shape of a Beast, Humanoid or Monstrosity of Challenge Rating 10 or lower for 1 hour and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points. The shape ends early when those Temporary Hit Points are gone or when you end it as a Magic action. You keep your creature type, alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, Hit Points and Hit Point Dice, proficiencies, ways of communicating, and your Spellcasting or Pact Magic.

benefits.name: Shifting Vigor
benefits.summary: Whenever changing your shape gives you Temporary Hit Points, you gain 20 more.
benefits.text: Whenever you gain Temporary Hit Points from changing your shape (this boon, Wild Shape and the like), you gain 20 more.
